# Scala suites the heavy CI job runs (build_main `build` job, via the scala_build action).
#
# One -Dsuites entry per line: an exact class name, or a package wildcard (`pkg.*`, which includes
# sub-packages). The action joins the lines with commas when its suite_pattern input is empty.
# A blank line or a line starting with `#` is ignored.
#
# Scala is the performance tier only: CI runs the suites of code the registered functions still
# reach (the L1 expressions, the kernel facades, the shared GDAL, tile, grid and vector primitives).
# The suites below are left out on purpose, because the code they test is reachable from no function.
# Each is named on a `# excluded:` line, and scripts/ci/test_scala_heavy_suites.py checks that every
# suite under src/test/scala is either matched by an entry or excluded here, and that every entry
# matches a suite.
#
# excluded: com.databricks.labs.gbx.rasterx.gdal.DirectReaderTest
# excluded: com.databricks.labs.gbx.rasterx.operations.GDALRasterizeTest
# excluded: com.databricks.labs.gbx.vectorx.mvt.MvtPyramidBuilderTest
#
# SparkAdaptersTest lives outside com.databricks.labs.gbx, so the old default wildcard skipped it.
